components.name: capture
components.reason: Pythonの画面取得に加え、任意のC++ WGC実装がある。frame単位で渡し、利用可否は実行時に確認する。

components.name: input
components.reason: OS input and release-all are latency/safety sensitive and should not depend on Python scheduling long term.

components.name: safety
components.reason: 意味判断と停止管理はPython、任意のC ABIによる決定論的検証はC++。manifestの宣言だけで独立した停止機構の成立を保証しない。

components.name: fast_cv
components.reason: Keep OpenCV/NumPy-backed work high-level while native code owns measured Python loops or latency-sensitive frame primitives.

components.name: decision_context
components.reason: Rapidly changing AI/orchestration logic benefits from Python and is not a per-pixel hot path.

components.name: model_orchestration
components.reason: AI/ML ecosystem integration and experimentation dominate over interpreter overhead.

components.name: evaluation_outcome
components.reason: High-level semantic policy remains separate from deterministic native safety.

components.name: ui_tooling
components.reason: UI/tooling is not currently latency-critical enough to justify another mandatory runtime.

components.name: game_rules_plugins
components.reason: Lua is a strong embedded rule/plugin candidate, but adding a mandatory script runtime before the plugin contract stabilizes has negative current net benefit.

lua.revisit_when: A stable plugin ABI exists and measured startup/deployment cost is smaller than the sandboxing and extension benefit.

csharp.revisit_when: Windows shell, accessibility, installer, tray, or lifecycle requirements materially exceed the current bundled Python UI capability.

javascript_typescript.revisit_when: A browser/web surface is implemented and can remain outside the safety-critical runtime path.
